title: Exclusive | Wonder Explores Sale of Food-Delivery Business Grubhub
html:
Wonder, a food delivery company started by Marc Lore, is exploring a sale of Grubhub, the delivery company it purchased in 2024, said people familiar with the matter.

Bankers have been in contact with Walmart WMT 1.52%increase; up pointing triangle, Target TGT -0.97%decrease; down pointing triangle, Kroger KR 0.74%increase; up pointing triangle and other retailers about a potential purchase, said the people. There are no guarantees a deal will come together.

summary: Marc Lore’s Wonder is exploring a sale of Grubhub, which it bought in 2024, as it focuses on its food-hall business, the WSJ reports.
